message: Initial mex scaffold port from monolithic CLAUDE.md (407 lines, 44KB) to .mex/{ROUTER,context/*,patterns/*}. Anchor reduced to 60 lines (3.7KB). Wikilinks normalised: CLAUDE.md uses .mex/ prefix; cross-folder refs inside .mex/ use ../ where needed.

Amend: añadida sección 'Interpreting mex check output' al CLAUDE.md anchor (60→82 líneas, 3.7→5.6KB). Lista taxonomía de falsos positivos del detector (URLs, globs, pytest::, line-ranges, code fragments con /, runtime files) y define qué cuenta como drift real. mex check ahora reporta 46 errors (vs 31 antes) porque la propia sección menciona los patrones que enseña a ignorar — efecto recursivo esperado.

Test del scaffold (arco DB closure analysis). FOUND: doc drift en #482/#483/#484 — los 3 numbers están swapeados cíclicamente en .mex/context/{conventions,decisions}.md (heredado del CLAUDE.md original). Realidad: #482=rate limit, #483=scan_id FK, #484=direction enum CHECK. Side-patch propuesto: fix en el primer PR de Tier 1. ALSO: scaffold NO tenía pattern para 'audit closure status of a domain arc + propose PR bundles' — candidato a patterns/audit-arc-closure.md.

Bundle 1 → PR #486 abierto en upstream (sssimon/trading-spacial). Closes #477 #481. Path 3 (honest narrowing) — soften del error message + docstrings + 1 test nuevo + 2 tests existentes re-anchorados a _build_validated_snapshot. Branch: feat/bundle-1-precheck-coherence. Bundle 1b (registry update en .mex/context/conventions.md) queda local en main hasta que el scaffold mex se promueva a upstream.

Tier 1+2+3 applied to PR #486 in commit c67e257 (cherry-picked to main as 1053e80). Issue #487 opened tracking sentinel-import wider asymmetry (Serrano F2). PR body amended Closes #477 → Advances #477 (registry row's substantive landing depends on scaffold promotion). Bundle 1b registry row updated to reflect Advances + #487. Plan doc footnoted (F7). 27/27 tests verde.

PR #512 merged 2026-05-26 (commit 415d791). Closes #477 via Path 6 (Voronov 4th meta-review reframe: rename + registry split + pattern section, not the 5 paths in the issue). 5th meta-review caught 4 implementation drifts (B1 word-validated redistributed; B2 recognition criteria descriptive not diagnostic; C1 ValidatedOpenRequest mis-classified as same pattern when structurally inverted; C2 missing name-mapping). All 4 fixed in-PR before merge: word validated retired from read-side, diagnostic question made load-bearing, factory-as-safety-organ sister-pattern documented separately, name-mapping nota added. ValidatedOpenRequest now has open follow-up (separate sub-task): decide closure pattern / name-mangling / frame inspection / accept-with-monitoring for its sentinel — Path 6 does NOT apply because the factory IS the safety organ, not a provenance marker.
